}}'''Farellien''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Farellien}}

==History==
[[Alviarin Freidhen]], acting in the interest of her true Ajah, the [[Black Ajah|Black]], ordered [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] to reward Farellin of the Yellow, [[Kiyoshi]] of the [[Gray Ajah|Gray]] and [[Doraise Mesianos]] of the [[Brown Ajah|Brown]] and uphold them as models of preserving the law. Farellien is given a new horse. Alviarin's goal was to create paranoia in the [[Tower|White Tower]] as none of the sisters involved had done anything to deserve such praise, and it implicated them as the informants on [[Adelorna Bastine]] and [[Josaine]], who were severely punished for keeping ''[[angreal]]'' and ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in their rooms{{Ref/book|7|32}}.
